units.source_text: 我没有向金阁告别，原因也在于此。

en.t: This was also why I did not say farewell to the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 因为必须是突然从包括金周在内的我的全环境中把我夺走。

en.t: Because I had to be suddenly torn away from my entire surroundings, including Jinzhou.
Little by little, I swept my way toward the temple gate.

units.source_text: 透过松树梢，可以望见晨星在闪烁。

en.t: Through the tops of the pine trees, the morning star could be seen glittering.
